description: Explain one EN 16931 / XRechnung / Peppol BIS rule in plain English: what it requires, why, the business term it constrains, a concrete fix and an example. 305 rules explained — BR-*, BR-CO-*, BR-<category>-*, BR-DE-*, PEPPOL-EN16931-* and this library's own ATW-*. That is every rule id this validator can report. Reach for it first whenever a rule id appears in an error, a log or a question, and to re-read an error you already have: validating again costs a document, this does not. FREE and needs no API key.

rule_id.description: The rule id, e.g. "BR-DE-15", "BR-CO-15", "BR-S-02", "PEPPOL-EN16931-R010". Case and separators are forgiving.
